title: West Pakistan Essential Services Maintenance Sindh Amendment Act 1973

sections.shortTitle: West Pakistan Essential Services Maintenance Sindh Amendment Act 1973
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT III OF 1973
ACT III OF 1973
WEST PAKISTAN
ESSENTIAL SERVICES (MAINTENANCE) (SIND AMENDMENT) ACT, 1973
An Act to amend
the West Pakistan Essential Services (Maintenance) Act, 1958, in its
application to the Province of Sind
[Gazette of Sind,
Extraordinary, Part IV, 29th June 1973]
(First published after hiving
received the assent of the Governor of Sind in the Gazette of Sind
(Extraordinary), dated 28th June 1973).
No. PAS/Legis-B-3/73.-The
West Pakistan Essential Services (Mainten ance) (Sind Amendment) Bill, 1973
having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Sind on the 5th June 1973 and
assented to by the Governor of Sind on the 27th June 1973, is hereby published
as an Act of the Legislature of Sind : --
1. Short title and
commencement.--(1) This Act may be called the West Pakistan Essential
Services (Maintenance) (Sind Amendment) Act, 1973.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

sections.shortTitle: West Pakistan Essential Services Maintenance Sindh Amendment Act 1973
sections.description:
Amendment of section 3 of West Pakistan Act XXXIV of 1958

ACT III OF 1973
ACT III OF 1973
WEST PAKISTAN
ESSENTIAL SERVICES (MAINTENANCE) (SIND AMENDMENT) ACT, 1973
An Act to amend
the West Pakistan Essential Services (Maintenance) Act, 1958, in its
application to the Province of Sind
[Gazette of Sind,
Extraordinary, Part IV, 29th June 1973]
(First published after hiving
received the assent of the Governor of Sind in the Gazette of Sind
(Extraordinary), dated 28th June 1973).
No. PAS/Legis-B-3/73.-The
West Pakistan Essential Services (Mainten ance) (Sind Amendment) Bill, 1973
having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Sind on the 5th June 1973 and
assented to by the Governor of Sind on the 27th June 1973, is hereby published
as an Act of the Legislature of Sind : --
2. Amendment of section 3 of
West Pakistan Act XXXIV of 1958.---In the West Pakistan Essential Services
(Maintenance) Act, 1958, in its applica tion to the Province of Sind, section 3
shall be renumbered as subsection (1) .of that section and after the subsection
so renumbered, the following subsection shall be added, namely :-
"(2)
Government may, by notification in the official Gazette, apply this Act to the
employment in any educational autonomous body, Including a University, Board of
Intermediate and Secondary Education, the Board of Technical Education, or any
part thereof."
